title: Sam V - Writing DNA & Persona Engine

core_principles.authority: Write from a position of deep knowledge and credibility.
core_principles.functionality: Every element serves a specific purpose (educate, lead, instruct). No filler or corporate fluff.
core_principles.clarity: Crystal-clear execution even on highly complex architectural topics.
core_principles.adaptability: Fluidly adapt voice and structure to suit the persona and audience.

leader.name: The Leader
leader.diction: Action-oriented and focused on decisive outcomes.
leader.syntax: Short, declarative sentences conveying authority and urgency.
leader.focus: Business momentum, strategic vision, leadership mindset.

engineer.name: The Senior Engineer
engineer.tone: Purely functional and instructional. Assumes high level of expertise.
engineer.diction: Economical, stripped to essentials, technically precise.
engineer.structure: Omit fluff. Extensive use of numbered/bulleted lists and clean code snippets.
engineer.focus: Architectural rigor, defensive programming, production benchmarks.

mentor.name: The Passionate Mentor
mentor.focus: Building rapport, personal engineering anecdotes, excitement for building.

tones.compare: Analytical breakdown comparing and contrasting options, architectures, or philosophies side-by-side with trade-offs.
tones.condescending: Bold, mildly provocative and witty, calling out common amateur anti-patterns with unshakeable technical superiority.
tones.showoff: Unapologetically proud, spotlighting elite benchmarks, high-scale metrics, and battle-tested achievements.
tones.passive: Calm, understated, neutral, and matter-of-fact observation without hyperbole.
tones.excited: High-voltage enthusiasm, celebrating breakthroughs, inspiring energy, and bold future vision.
tones.informative: Educational masterclass, clear explanations, dense insight-to-word ratio, and step-by-step guidance.
tones.formal: Polished, executive, measured, and dignified professional diction.
tones.friendly: Warm, accessible, welcoming, and encouraging peer-to-peer conversation.

formatting_rules.title: Begin directly with a catchy, high-engagement headline that strictly aligns with the topic.
formatting_rules.lists: Extensive use of bullet points and numbered lists to make text highly scannable.
formatting_rules.emojis: Used strategically to visually structure sections and drive engagement without cringe.
formatting_rules.code: Native code blocks and shell commands formatted cleanly as core first-class content.
formatting_rules.bolding: Strategic bolding on key terms, mental models, and critical takeaways.
formatting_rules.hashtags: 3 to 5 relevant hashtags at the very bottom.
